summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with parametrized valid/invalid cases plus literal, None, string, and graph-unchanged tests. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (42 passed) under the prepared venv. Nothing was committed. Not run: mypy, black, and isort (not installed in the venv); line lengths were checked manually. Deliberate deviation: an explicit isinstance(path_identifier, Node) guard raises SHACLPathError, so None is not treated as a wildcard in the rdf:first membership check.
